messages:
jordan (AE): Quick sync — NetBank wants POC next week. Core asks: SSO via SAML (Okta + signed assertions), SCIM delta provisioning, RBAC group->role mapping, domain verification for tenant separation, and a legal request for dataflow diagram. Need pricing ballpark for dedicated vs hosted. Anyone able to confirm constraints?

mike (SE): @jordan we can do SAML 2.0 with signed assertions. IdP metadata upload supported. Also support SAML attribute mapping to set subject/role.

mike (SE): SCIM: we implement RFC7644, support incremental sync via ETag / If-Match and filtering. Default rate limit is 10 req/s per tenant; can increase on Dedicated. For large orgs recommend Bulk endpoint or chunked imports.

mike (SE): For RBAC, map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles using group.externalId or a custom attribute. We also support SCIM PATCH for incremental group membership updates.

ashley (SD): Pricing note: Dedicated reserved capacity starts around $25k/mo for small clusters, add-ons for VPC peering and CMK. Hosted eval still possible (credits) for initial tests. I'll confirm exact SKUs.

sam (Security): Need to confirm: is customer-managed KMS supported in Private/Dedicated? What's our default log retention? SOC2 status? Legal also wants a brief dataflow diagram and list of where PII may touch (if any). @mike any quick callouts?

mike (SE): Yes, CMK supported on Private and Dedicated via KMS/HSM integrations. Data at rest encrypted AES-256, in transit TLS1.2+. We are SOC2 Type II; AOC available under NDA.

mike (SE): I'll assemble a minimal dataflow diagram for legal. For the POC we can run hosted with private network peering or Dedicated eval — avoids full on-prem install if they prefer.

jordan (AE): NetBank legal also asked for SCIM deletion behaviour and proof of domain ownership (they prefer per-tenant DNS TXT). What's the domain proofing flow?

mike (SE): Domain verification options: DNS TXT or email to WHOIS/admin contact. For enterprise we recommend DNS TXT. Once verified we persist the domain-to-tenant binding; changes require a support ticket and re-verification.

ashley (SD): Next steps: schedule kickoff Tues 10am PT. Jordan — send IdP metadata and a test user. Also drop the customer's security questionnaire to me and @sam so we can triage.

jordan (AE): On it. Adding legal contact sarah@netbank.com. They also want an example SCIM curl to validate PATCH/ETag behaviour — mike, can you paste a quick example?

mike (SE): Sure:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/123" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","value":{"active":true}}]}'
```

mike (SE): That will show PATCH support and ETag checks if you include If-Match header. For bulk imports use the Bulk endpoint: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Bulk" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{...}'
```

deploy-bot: Provisioned POC namespace 'netbank-poc-2026' in us-west-2. Credentials sent to jordan via DM.

jordan (AE): Received creds. @sam I'll DM the security questionnaire. Can we get a short written note for procurement comparing hosted eval vs dedicated commit pricing/SLAs?

ashley (SD): I'll post a one-pager by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam (Security): Also flagging audit log retention — default 90 days, extension possible with Dedicated/enterprise add-on. I'll call that out in my questionnaire answers.

jordan (AE): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update this thread after the kickoff and attach the IdP metadata + test account details.
